data.name: Bahman
data.gender_notes: Bahman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Persian language, Bahman means 'bringer of good fortune'. In Islamic tradition, it is the name of the twelfth month in the Persian calendar and is associated with wisdom and power. The name Bahman carries the meaning “Wise, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahman usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah grant you wisdom and strength.
data.etymology: Bahman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahman total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: بَهمن
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم الذي يعني العمدة أو القائد في فارسية
in_arabic.long_meaning: البَهمن هو اسم فارسِيّ يعني العمدة أو القائد. يظهر هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة يوسف آية 33. ويُعد هذا الاسم من الأسماء النبوية في الإسلام. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة العربية والإسلامية لوصف الشخص الذي له القدرة العليا. يأتي هذا الاسم من اللغة الفارسية، التي تأتي من اللغة الأوربية. وبالتالي، يعد هذا الاسم من أهم الأسماء التي تعكس الثقافة الفارسية في الإسلام.

in_english.name: Bahman
in_english.meaning: A Persian name meaning leader or ruler, associated with Fars monarchs
in_english.long_meaning: Bahman is a Persian name meaning leader or ruler, associated with Fars monarchs. This name appears in the Quran in the story of Joseph. It is also used in Islamic terminology to denote a leader or ruler. The name Bahman is derived from the Persian language, indicating its association with the Fars people. In Islamic tradition, Bahman is seen as a symbol of leadership and power, reflecting the values of the Fars monarchy.

The name Bahman, in its spiritual interpretation, embodies the attributes of God such as wisdom, guidance, and compassion. By embracing the name Bahman, one can seek its blessings in their daily lives and strive towards becoming closer to God.
